package student

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type practiceTaskLessonPlan struct {
	current            *partRuntimeContext
	milestone          domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	lesson             *answeruc.LessonMetadata
	orderedLessons     []answeruc.LessonMetadata
	lessonIndexByID    map[string]int
	currentLessonID    string
	milestoneBlock     string
	milestoneRedirect  string
	prerequisites      domain.MilestonePrerequisites
	completedLessonIDs map[string]struct{}
}

const (
	practiceTaskBlockingReasonCompletePrevTask = "COMPLETE_PREVIOUS_TASK"
	practiceTaskCourseContentStatusActive      = 1
)

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ResolvePracticeTaskLessonAccess(ctx context.Context, studentID, lessonID string) (*answeruc.LessonAccess, error) {
	plan, err := useCase.loadPracticeTaskLessonPlan(ctx, studentID, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	index, ok := plan.lessonIndexByID[lessonID]
	if !ok || plan.lesson == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	completed := practiceTaskLessonCompleted(plan.completedLessonIDs, lessonID)
	current := !completed && plan.currentLessonID == lessonID && plan.milestoneBlock == ""

	for _, previousLesson := range plan.orderedLessons[:index] {
		if practiceTaskLessonsSharePrerequisiteGroup(plan.current.partMilestones, previousLesson.ID, lessonID) {
			continue
		}
		if practiceTaskRouteRequirementSatisfied(plan.current.partMilestones, previousLesson.ID, plan.completedLessonIDs) {
			continue
		}
		return &answeruc.LessonAccess{
			LessonID:         lessonID,
			CourseID:         plan.lesson.CourseID,
			Locked:           true,
			Completed:        completed,
			Current:          false,
			BlockingReason:   blockingReasonStrictOrderRequired,
			RedirectLessonID: previousLesson.ID,
		}, nil
	}

	if plan.milestoneBlock != "" && !completed {
		redirectLessonID := plan.milestoneRedirect
		if redirectLessonID == "" && plan.currentLessonID != lessonID {
			redirectLessonID = plan.currentLessonID
		}
		return &answeruc.LessonAccess{
			LessonID:         lessonID,
			CourseID:         plan.lesson.CourseID,
			Locked:           true,
			Completed:        completed,
			Current:          false,
			BlockingReason:   plan.milestoneBlock,
			RedirectLessonID: redirectLessonID,
		}, nil
	}

	return &answeruc.LessonAccess{
		LessonID:  lessonID,
		CourseID:  plan.lesson.CourseID,
		Locked:    false,
		Completed: completed,
		Current:   current,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ResolvePracticeTaskTaskAccess(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskID string) (*answeruc.TaskAccess, error) {
	scope, ok := answeruc.PracticeTaskScopeFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	lessonAccess, err := useCase.ResolvePracticeTaskLessonAccess(ctx, studentID, scope.LessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if useCase.CourseContent == nil || useCase.Answers == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	lesson, err := useCase.CourseContent.GetLesson(ctx, scope.LessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	structure, err := useCase.CourseContent.GetCourseStructure(ctx, lesson.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	activeTasks := practiceTaskLessonTasks(structure, scope.LessonID)
	progressMap, err := useCase.Answers.GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx, studentID, practiceTaskTaskIDs(activeTasks))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var currentTaskID string
	for _, item := range activeTasks {
		if practiceTaskTaskCompleted(item, progressMap[item.ID]) {
			continue
		}
		currentTaskID = item.ID
		break
	}

	var selectedTask *answeruc.CourseStructureTask
	for index := range activeTasks {
		if activeTasks[index].ID != taskID {
			continue
		}
		item := activeTasks[index]
		selectedTask = &item
		break
	}
	if selectedTask == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	completed := practiceTaskTaskCompleted(*selectedTask, progressMap[selectedTask.ID])
	if lessonAccess.Locked {
		return &answeruc.TaskAccess{
			TaskID:           taskID,
			LessonID:         scope.LessonID,
			CourseID:         lesson.CourseID,
			Locked:           true,
			Completed:        completed,
			Current:          false,
			Readonly:         completed,
			BlockingReason:   lessonAccess.BlockingReason,
			RedirectLessonID: lessonAccess.RedirectLessonID,
		}, nil
	}
	if completed {
		return &answeruc.TaskAccess{
			TaskID:    taskID,
			LessonID:  scope.LessonID,
			CourseID:  lesson.CourseID,
			Locked:    false,
			Completed: true,
			Current:   false,
			Readonly:  true,
		}, nil
	}
	if currentTaskID != "" && currentTaskID != taskID {
		return &answeruc.TaskAccess{
			TaskID:           taskID,
			LessonID:         scope.LessonID,
			CourseID:         lesson.CourseID,
			Locked:           true,
			Completed:        false,
			Current:          false,
			Readonly:         false,
			BlockingReason:   practiceTaskBlockingReasonCompletePrevTask,
			RedirectLessonID: scope.LessonID,
			RedirectTaskID:   currentTaskID,
		}, nil
	}

	return &answeruc.TaskAccess{
		TaskID:    taskID,
		LessonID:  scope.LessonID,
		CourseID:  lesson.CourseID,
		Locked:    false,
		Completed: false,
		Current:   true,
		Readonly:  false,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadPracticeTaskLessonPlan(ctx context.Context, studentID, lessonID string) (*practiceTaskLessonPlan, error) {
	scope, ok := answeruc.PracticeTaskScopeFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if useCase.CourseContent == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	current, err := useCase.loadPartRuntimeContext(ctx, studentID, scope.StudentPracticeTaskID, scope.PartID, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var milestone *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	for index := range current.partMilestones {
		if current.partMilestones[index].ID != scope.MilestoneID {
			continue
		}
		item := current.partMilestones[index]
		milestone = &item
		break
	}
	if milestone == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	prerequisites := resolvePartMilestonePrerequisites(current.runtimeContext, *milestone, current.completedLessonIDs)
	milestoneLessons, err := useCase.orderPracticeTaskMilestoneLessons(ctx, *milestone, prerequisites)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !practiceTaskLessonInList(milestoneLessons, lessonID) {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	orderedLessons, err := useCase.orderPracticeTaskPartLessons(ctx, current)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lessonIndexByID := make(map[string]int, len(orderedLessons))
	var lessonMeta *answeruc.LessonMetadata
	currentRequiredLessonID := ""
	currentRecommendedLessonID := ""
	currentOptionalLessonID := ""
	for index := range orderedLessons {
		item := orderedLessons[index]
		lessonIndexByID[item.ID] = index
		if !practiceTaskLessonCompleted(current.completedLessonIDs, item.ID) {
			switch practiceTaskRouteLessonRequirement(current.partMilestones, item.ID) {
			case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRecommended:
				if currentRecommendedLessonID == "" {
					currentRecommendedLessonID = item.ID
				}
			case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementOptional:
				if currentOptionalLessonID == "" {
					currentOptionalLessonID = item.ID
				}
			default:
				if currentRequiredLessonID == "" && !practiceTaskRouteRequirementSatisfied(current.partMilestones, item.ID, current.completedLessonIDs) {
					currentRequiredLessonID = item.ID
				}
			}
		}
		if item.ID == lessonID {
			copy := item
			lessonMeta = &copy
		}
	}
	if lessonMeta == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	currentLessonID := currentRequiredLessonID
	if currentLessonID == "" {
		currentLessonID = currentRecommendedLessonID
	}
	if currentLessonID == "" {
		currentLessonID = currentOptionalLessonID
	}

	milestoneBlock := practiceTaskMilestoneLessonBlock(current, *milestone, prerequisites)
	return &practiceTaskLessonPlan{
		current:            current,
		milestone:          *milestone,
		lesson:             lessonMeta,
		orderedLessons:     orderedLessons,
		lessonIndexByID:    lessonIndexByID,
		currentLessonID:    currentLessonID,
		milestoneBlock:     milestoneBlock,
		milestoneRedirect:  practiceTaskMilestoneLessonRedirect(current, *milestone, milestoneBlock),
		prerequisites:      prerequisites,
		completedLessonIDs: current.completedLessonIDs,
	}, nil
}

func practiceTaskMilestoneLessonRedirect(current *partRuntimeContext, milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, block string) string {
	if current == nil || current.runtimeContext == nil || block == "" {
		return ""
	}

	var blockerID string
	switch block {
	case blockingReasonParentMilestoneRequired:
		blockerID = parentPartMilestoneID(milestone)
	case blockingReasonPreviousMilestone:
		blockerID = previousRouteMilestoneID(current.runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, milestone)
	case blockingReasonStrictOrderRequired:
		blockerID = previousSiblingMilestoneID(current.partMilestones, milestone)
	}
	if blockerID == "" {
		return ""
	}

	for _, candidate := range current.runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones {
		if candidate.ID != blockerID {
			continue
		}
		bindings := sortedRuntimeLessonBindings(candidate.LessonBindings)
		for _, binding := range bindings {
			if !practiceTaskLessonCompleted(current.completedLessonIDs, binding.LessonID) {
				return binding.LessonID
			}
		}
		if len(bindings) > 0 {
			return bindings[0].LessonID
		}
		return ""
	}
	return ""
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) orderPracticeTaskLessons(ctx context.Context, lessonIDs []string) ([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, error) {
	result := make([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, 0, len(lessonIDs))
	for _, lessonID := range lessonIDs {
		item, err := useCase.CourseContent.GetLesson(ctx, lessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, *item)
	}
	sort.SliceStable(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		if result[left].CourseID != result[right].CourseID {
			return result[left].CourseID < result[right].CourseID
		}
		if result[left].Order != result[right].Order {
			return result[left].Order < result[right].Order
		}
		return result[left].ID < result[right].ID
	})
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) orderPracticeTaskMilestoneLessons(ctx context.Context, milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, prerequisites domain.MilestonePrerequisites) ([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, error) {
	if len(milestone.LessonBindings) == 0 {
		return useCase.orderPracticeTaskLessons(ctx, prerequisites.MatchedLessonIDs)
	}
	return useCase.loadPracticeTaskBoundLessonsInOrder(ctx, sortedRuntimeLessonBindings(milestone.LessonBindings))
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadPracticeTaskBoundLessonsInOrder(ctx context.Context, bindings []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding) ([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, error) {
	result := make([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, 0, len(bindings))
	for _, binding := range bindings {
		item, err := useCase.CourseContent.GetLesson(ctx, binding.LessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(binding.CourseID) != "" && item.CourseID != binding.CourseID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: lesson %s belongs to course %s, not %s", domain.ErrValidation, binding.LessonID, item.CourseID, binding.CourseID)
		}
		result = append(result, *item)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadPracticeTaskLessonsInOrder(ctx context.Context, lessonIDs []string) ([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, error) {
	result := make([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, 0, len(lessonIDs))
	for _, lessonID := range lessonIDs {
		item, err := useCase.CourseContent.GetLesson(ctx, lessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, *item)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) orderPracticeTaskPartLessons(ctx context.Context, current *partRuntimeContext) ([]answeruc.LessonMetadata, error) {
	if current == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	lessonIDs := make([]string, 0)
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	hasExplicitRoute := false
	for _, milestone := range current.partMilestones {
		prerequisites := resolvePartMilestonePrerequisites(current.runtimeContext, milestone, current.completedLessonIDs)
		milestoneLessonIDs := prerequisites.MatchedLessonIDs
		if len(milestone.LessonBindings) > 0 {
			hasExplicitRoute = true
			milestoneLessonIDs = make([]string, 0, len(milestone.LessonBindings))
			for _, binding := range sortedRuntimeLessonBindings(milestone.LessonBindings) {
				milestoneLessonIDs = append(milestoneLessonIDs, binding.LessonID)
			}
		}
		for _, lessonID := range milestoneLessonIDs {
			if _, ok := seen[lessonID]; ok {
				continue
			}
			seen[lessonID] = struct{}{}
			lessonIDs = append(lessonIDs, lessonID)
		}
	}
	if !hasExplicitRoute {
		return useCase.orderPracticeTaskLessons(ctx, lessonIDs)
	}
	return useCase.loadPracticeTaskLessonsInOrder(ctx, lessonIDs)
}

func practiceTaskRouteRequirementSatisfied(milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, lessonID string, completedLessonIDs map[string]struct{}) bool {
	if practiceTaskLessonCompleted(completedLessonIDs, lessonID) {
		return true
	}
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		for _, binding := range milestone.LessonBindings {
			if binding.LessonID != lessonID {
				continue
			}
			if binding.Requirement != domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired {
				return true
			}
			if binding.AlternativeGroup == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*binding.AlternativeGroup) == "" {
				return false
			}
			group := strings.TrimSpace(*binding.AlternativeGroup)
			for _, alternative := range milestone.LessonBindings {
				if alternative.AlternativeGroup == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*alternative.AlternativeGroup) != group {
					continue
				}
				if practiceTaskLessonCompleted(completedLessonIDs, alternative.LessonID) {
					return true
				}
			}
			return false
		}
	}
	// Skill-tag fallback has no requirement metadata, so it remains required.
	return false
}

func practiceTaskRouteLessonRequirement(milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, lessonID string) string {
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		for _, binding := range milestone.LessonBindings {
			if binding.LessonID == lessonID {
				return binding.Requirement
			}
		}
	}
	return domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired
}

func practiceTaskLessonsSharePrerequisiteGroup(milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, leftLessonID, rightLessonID string) bool {
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		var leftGroup, rightGroup string
		for _, binding := range milestone.LessonBindings {
			switch binding.LessonID {
			case leftLessonID:
				if binding.PrerequisiteGroup != nil {
					leftGroup = strings.TrimSpace(*binding.PrerequisiteGroup)
				}
			case rightLessonID:
				if binding.PrerequisiteGroup != nil {
					rightGroup = strings.TrimSpace(*binding.PrerequisiteGroup)
				}
			}
		}
		if leftGroup != "" && leftGroup == rightGroup {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func practiceTaskLessonInList(items []answeruc.LessonMetadata, lessonID string) bool {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.ID == lessonID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func practiceTaskMilestoneLessonBlock(
	current *partRuntimeContext,
	milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone,
	prerequisites domain.MilestonePrerequisites,
) string {
	if len(prerequisites.UnmatchedSkillTags) > 0 {
		return blockingReasonMilestonePrerequisites
	}
	if parentID := parentPartMilestoneID(milestone); parentID != "" {
		parent, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[parentID]
		if !ok || !isMilestoneCompleted(parent.Status) {
			return blockingReasonParentMilestoneRequired
		}
	}
	if previousID := previousRouteMilestoneID(current.runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, milestone); previousID != "" {
		previous, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[previousID]
		if !ok || !isMilestoneCompleted(previous.Status) {
			return blockingReasonPreviousMilestone
		}
	}
	if current.part.IsStrictOrder {
		if previousID := previousSiblingMilestoneID(current.partMilestones, milestone); previousID != "" {
			previousMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[previousID]
			if ok && !isMilestoneCompleted(previousMilestone.Status) {
				return blockingReasonStrictOrderRequired
			}
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func practiceTaskLessonCompleted(completedLessonIDs map[string]struct{}, lessonID string) bool {
	_, ok := completedLessonIDs[lessonID]
	return ok
}

func practiceTaskLessonTasks(structure *answeruc.CourseStructure, lessonID string) []answeruc.CourseStructureTask {
	if structure == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for _, lesson := range structure.Lessons {
		if lesson.ID != lessonID {
			continue
		}
		result := make([]answeruc.CourseStructureTask, 0, len(lesson.Tasks))
		for _, task := range lesson.Tasks {
			if task.Status != practiceTaskCourseContentStatusActive {
				continue
			}
			result = append(result, task)
		}
		sort.SliceStable(result, func(left, right int) bool {
			if result[left].Order == result[right].Order {
				return result[left].ID < result[right].ID
			}
			return result[left].Order < result[right].Order
		})
		return result
	}
	return nil
}

func practiceTaskTaskIDs(items []answeruc.CourseStructureTask) []string {
	if len(items) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		result = append(result, item.ID)
	}
	return result
}

func practiceTaskTaskCompleted(task answeruc.CourseStructureTask, progress domain.StudentTaskProgress) bool {
	if progress.HasPassed {
		return true
	}
	switch task.EvaluationMode {
	case "MANUAL", "HYBRID":
		return progress.HasUnderReview
	default:
		return false
	}
}
